title: Comparison: queue options
question: How should the queue comparison present its three options?

options.label: One table
options.description: Options as columns, criteria as rows, a recommendation line above. Best for scanning differences.

options.label: Side-by-side cards
options.description: One card per option with pros and cons. Reads well, harder to compare one criterion across all three.

options.label: Table plus notes
options.description: The table for the numbers and a short paragraph per option for the nuance.

content: The team is choosing between Pub/Sub, SQS and a database-backed queue. The decision turns on cost, ordering guarantees and operational load.
